claim: A self-chosen two-minute gateway can increase voluntary starts without reducing intrinsic interest.

nodes.text: A self-chosen two-minute gateway can increase voluntary starts without reducing intrinsic interest.
If a self-chosen two-minute gateway can increase voluntary starts without lowering intrinsic interest, at least one eligible context must show both outcomes together.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: A study of that conjunction must distinguish initiated inquiry from time spent preparing and must record inherent interest separately.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: Given a comparison that holds the chosen question and freedom to decline fixed, the manipulated gateway can be separated from a change in task content.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: If groups are randomly assigned to the gateway and equally optional active-control conditions, measured baseline differences are not a required explanation of an average difference.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: If the planned comparison preserves optionality and measures both endpoints, a positive start effect still needs an interest-loss bound before satisfying the no-reduction part.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: A predefined start threshold and interest-loss margin make a future result classifiable as supporting, conflicting or unresolved for the operationalized hypothesis.
nodes.strength: Possible under the explicit case premises

nodes.text: Deferred test: compare a voluntary gateway and an equally voluntary active control using the predeclared substantive-start outcome and interest-loss margin. No participants or outcome data are available in this run.
nodes.bedrock: BEDROCK-TEST-DEFERRED: real participant/data unavailable

nodes.text: Changing the margin after seeing results would test a new hypothesis.

nodes.text: FORECLOSED: failure to find a significant interest decrease is not itself evidence of no meaningful decrease.
nodes.bedrock: BEDROCK-LOGIC or explicitly deferred human test in statement

nodes.text: A predeclared noninferiority margin operationalizes a bounded version; exact zero loss is harder and remains distinct.

tests: Local measurement application: mock event sequence offered/access missing is marked no accessible opportunity; offered/declined is a decline; offered/accepted/example written is a substantive start. These are constructed classifications, not participant outcomes.

All causal human predictions are deferred because there are no participants, independent consented conditions, repeated opportunity records or interest outcomes. The separate EXD design specifies what would be measured.
